subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N63TU across all 2 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N63TU appears in the 6 Series 650i and 7 Series 750i.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild. Additional components — crankshaft, cylinder head, VANOS components, oil pump, cooling system, fuel injectors, HPFP, turbocharger, and PCV system — are inspected and measured.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The N63TU is part of BMW's hot-vee V8 family. While the TU revision improved some earlier N63 characteristics, valve seal and coolant system wear remain present. We account for these during a full rebuild.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N63TU rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
